speaker: john_heminges
text: You are early, Will. Nine was the hour you set yourself. Titus is at two.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: Two of the clock, and I am done in the fourth act. I would rather have the last cue now than hunt it with the jaw.

speaker: abel_garnish
text: The last cue is the one on your roll. I did not move it. You die, the scene goes on, and the book does not wait for a man who is already off.

speaker: thomas_pope
text: And do I wait on that death, or do I come in on the next?

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: You do not wait on me, Thomas. When I am down, the act still has its business. Yours is later. I will not keep you standing over a dead man.

speaker: john_heminges
text: Fourth act. Say it again, so the book and the plot agree.

speaker: abel_garnish
text: Fourth act. I have it so. He is not in the fifth. If any man has written him into the fifth, that man is wrong, and the book is right.

speaker: thomas_pope
text: How much of you is there before it?

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: Enough to be an old Roman, and not enough to be a long one. I counted the cues once this morning. I did not count them twice.

speaker: john_heminges
text: Will the jaw do the consonants at two?

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: It will do them once. I am not offering a second time in the passage. Eleven lines at home were enough writing for a mouth.

speaker: abel_garnish
text: Eleven lines are your sheet. They are not this roll. Do not bring Verona into a Roman plot. I will not book it.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: I will not. The eleven lines stay at the lodging. This house gets the Roman, and only that.

speaker: thomas_pope
text: There was a bill for the Rose. Seven Days and Wise Man. I read it on a post. I did not go nearer than the post.

speaker: john_heminges
text: That is their afternoon. Ours is one play. Titus, at two. I want the yard to know which house it came to.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: I will know the afternoon by being dead. That is enough of a share of the work.

speaker: abel_garnish
text: Then the exit is the one in the book. You go off. You stay off. If the house calls you, the house is late, and the book is not.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: I go off. I stay off. If the fourth act runs long, it is not because I am still in it.

speaker: john_heminges
text: If it runs long I will look at the book, not at you. Thomas, your cue is your own. Do not borrow his death to find it.

speaker: thomas_pope
text: I have never borrowed a death yet. I will not start with a Roman one. Two of the clock. I will be dressed before he is cold.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: Be dressed. The left side of the mouth is arguing, and I would rather it argue with me than with the yard.

speaker: abel_garnish
text: The roll stands. A tooth is not a reason to give a man's lines away.

speaker: john_heminges
text: Then we are set. Two of the clock. One play. He dies in the fourth. I will tell the hired men the same, and in fewer words.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: Say that. Nothing else left the lodging this morning. I am here for the play, and for the play only.

speaker: thomas_pope
text: And if a word fails in the jaw, do I take it up?

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: You do not take it up. The word is mine until I am dead, and after that there is nothing left to take.
